summary: Completed backend and frontend verification for location resolution, geolocation failure handling, silent performAction, cancel pulse, and sequence regressions. All 15 backend tests and all requested functional UI flows passed. One low-priority attribution contrast issue was found during design review.

issues: The 9px #39424f attribution text on #070a0f has approximately 1.95:1 contrast, below WCAG text contrast guidance and visibly very faint.

action_items: Increase the OpenStreetMap attribution text color contrast and preferably its 9px font size.
Consider pruning expired entries from the in-memory location cache so unique coordinate buckets cannot accumulate indefinitely.
critical_code_review_comments: useLocation performs the initial refresh and correctly wires setInterval(refresh, CONFIG.LOCATION_REFRESH_MS), where the config resolves to 300000ms; overlapping refreshes are guarded.
The backend cache checks TTL but never removes expired coordinate keys, so a long-running multi-user process can grow _cache without a bound.
seed_data_creation: None; location requests only populated the process-local reverse-geocode cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview was tested. Granted GPS resolved 'NHCS Layout, Bengaluru' with OpenStreetMap attribution; denied GPS showed 'Location unavailable'. Cancel pulse peaked at 0.348 and returned to zero 386ms after first visible sample; cancellation returned Ready with 221/221 green polygons. Full cycle returned Ready in 15267ms. Boot had 153 dark/68 green polygons and idle shimmer changed 134/221 opacities. No console errors or performAction messages occurred. Earlier two cancel automation attempts failed only because of test-side timing/color assertions; the corrected browser-timestamp/computed-style test passed.
rca_of_the_issue: Location attribution uses color #39424f at 9px over #070a0f, yielding only about 1.95:1 contrast. Functional location, pulse, and sequence behavior had no reproduced product defect.
